_about: Proposed design tokens for the CITE 2026 workshop deck. Units are points on a 960x540 canvas (= 13.333in x 7.5in at 72pt/in), the same coordinate system scripts/build_cite_deck.py already uses. Brand hexes were measured from Files/Mark-Title-COLOR-ForLightBG.png pixel counts, not guessed. Status: PROPOSAL, round 1; the lead decides.

brand_gold.source: logo seal ring and bell, 41,434 px

ink.use: body and title text on light

ink_muted.use: secondary text on light (8.81:1 on white)

rule.use: meaningful lines and borders (6.15:1, passes 3:1 non-text)

hairline.use: decorative separators only; never the only boundary of a control-like element

stage.use: terminal / prompt stage on demo and lab slides (navy derived from brand blue)

stage_accent.use: prompt marker, labels on stage/black (9.10:1 on stage, 11.36:1 on black)

ok.use: checkpoint 'working' row, always with check glyph + word

partial.use: checkpoint 'partial' row, always with tilde glyph + word

blocked.use: checkpoint 'blocked' row, always with cross glyph + word

contexts._about: Shell/context tab shown above every command or prompt block, on slides and in the workbook. Meaning is carried by the label text and border style, so it survives grayscale print and projectors. No prompt marker ($, PS>) is drawn inside the copyable text.

routes._about: Canonical route names proposed to reconcile teaching (run / review) and linux (live agent / local files+Python / paper). Equal visual weight on every slide that names them.

status_call._about: Mid-lab show of hands, drawn as a strip on lab slides; replaces the round-1 standalone checkpoint slide.

forbidden_pairs.why: gold is never text or a meaningful mark on white (1.85:1)
brand blue never carries meaning on black (2.62:1); use white or gold
passes AA-large only (4.34:1); avoid for text at projector distance

type._font_note: Arial and Consolas both ship with Microsoft Office on macOS and Windows (Consolas found in /Applications/Microsoft PowerPoint.app/Contents/Resources/DFonts). Andale Mono, used by the current script, is macOS-only and will be substituted on a Windows presenter machine.

meta.use: eyebrow, footer, clock; never essential content

density._code_note: Measured Consolas advance 11.0pt/char at 20pt (Pillow 13.0.0, PowerPoint DFonts/Consola.ttf); 824pt inner panel = 74.9 chars. 72 at 20pt; 82 at the 18pt floor; longer lines go to the workbook only.
